method: Neighbourhood-first research (Thảo Điền, approved search area). Desk research from guides/official pages naming the venue AND the exact item (search-result excerpts; direct fetches blocked — spot-check). Coordinates: OpenStreetMap; venues with conflicting addresses withheld.

offerings.evidence: Matchaplaces lists Anh Coffee Matcha Bar at 37 Thảo Điền as a matcha bar (matcha drinks), open about 8:00–21:00/22:00.
Vietcetera's Thảo Điền guide (Jul 2025) describes Cafe 1/4 in Oishi Town as a matcha-focused café serving matcha lattes and affogatos.

venues.name: The Snap Cafe

offerings.evidence: Trip.com listing (user reviews) for The Snap Cafe, 32 Trần Ngọc Diện, praises its egg coffee.

venues.excluded: Address conflict: the source gives 32 Trần Ngọc Diện, but OpenStreetMap maps No. 32 as a different business (node 5388501721) and places 'The Snap Cafe' ~350 m east (node 9587618750). Not published until the location is confirmed.
